start.text: Day seven. The site is back, the customers are happy, and the morning is quiet. At 09:40, the phone rings.
start.name: Joshua

B.text: IT desk, this is Joshua. How can I help?
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Joshua? It's Tessa, at the front desk. I got an email that says my password expires today. It looks like IT, but it feels hurried. Is it real?
C.name: Tessa

D1.text: No. I asked first. It just felt odd.
D1.name: Tessa

E1.text: Good habit. That is the best thing anyone can do.
E1.name: Joshua

D2.text: Forty of us, I think. It was in everybody's inbox at 09:12.
D2.name: Tessa

F.text: Then we look at it closely. Where it comes from, and where its link really goes. Not how it looks.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: [b][color=green]5 clues[/color][/b] should be enough. Then I look at the two messages side by side and say what was fake.
G.name: Joshua
